title: Optus $350 300GB 365-Day Prepaid SIM Starter Kit for $199 + 2000 Bonus Points in-Store Only @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: Optus $350 300GB 365-Day Prepaid SIM Starter Kit for $199 + 2000 Bonus Points in-Store Only @ Woolworths

[BargainMe] Not everyone shops at Woolworths or is an Everyday Rewards customer
[bpdoz] If I'm currently with Optus monthly-post-plan, can I transfer my same number to this prepaid plan?
[smog] It says new services only, but you can just buy a $2 sim with any telco and port out and back into Optus.
[xwx] Any telco remain where you get active #, or number porting for only $2?
[smog] Any telco should work. I recently used a Telstra $2 sim and ported an existing number from Amaysim out and back in for one of their starter kit. It only took 15 minute all up.
If you're referring to keeping an active number for the cheapest plan for up to a year then Amaysim or Aldi is your best bet.
https://www.reddit.com/r/AussieFrugal/comments/1og4j1j/cheap…
[xwx] @smog: Thanks for reply, appreciated! I thought you needed to pay a recharge amount now on all of the super cheap mobile prepaid sims, before it would port or activate a new number.
[smog] @xwx: When I ported into Telstra, they did ask if you wanted to recharge and I clicked no and ported out as soon the service was active. Not sure on how other telco works, so might be best to double check their website before using them.
[xwx] @smog: Checked a few forums, and it seems Telstra provide 7days without recharge.
[Stalker] Need to churn from Boost soon. Is there any good reason why I should get this over the current Amaysim deal with cashback? https://www.shopback.com.au/amaysim-mobile
[Stalker] Yep, with $90 cash back…so basically half price
[Mr Beans] For how long we have to port out for ? Thanks
[sajidmib] Can’t beat the $70 for Optus 365 prepaid sim deal with shopback cashback.
[jezza p] It’s this sim. There was a finder gift Visa card thing going for a bit where you pay $220 and get $150 Visa gift card as reward. No longer available. They ran out pretty quickly when it went online.
[Cho0028] Does this have actual 5G or is this their capped nonsense?
